text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Donlands Avenue, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is recommending that existing corner parking prohibition on the west side of Donlands Avenue, north of Aldwych Avenue, be changed to a standing prohibition. The proposed amendment will further deter parking at this location, will improve sightlines for drivers making turning from Aldwych Avenue, and support accessible student pick-up and drop-off by maintaining a clear curb space.
City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit standing at all times on the west side of Donlands Avenue, between Aldwych Avenue and a point 18 metres north.
